title: Titanium: EXO
description: A mod that adds exoskeletons, new resources, and more.
body:
**TITANIUM — Enhance your survivability with advanced exoskeletons and precision engineering.**

_Features:_

  **Exoskeletons**: Master modular suits that enhance your strength, speed, and agility.

  **Super Strength**: Upgrade your exoskeleton with armor for maximum protection.

  **New Materials**: Explore a new development path from iron components to high-quality titanium alloys.

  **Tools and Gears**: Use specialized tools like a hammer to create complex mechanical parts.

_(Currently in beta. Your feedback, bug reports, and ideas are what drive this project forward!)_
